situations.title: iPhone 4 Antenna Issue

situations.outcome: Neutralized PR crisis while avoiding recall

situations.title: AWS S3 Outage Response
situations.situation: Major AWS S3 outage affected thousands of customers and websites
situations.response: Transparent technical post-mortem, implemented new safeguards, improved monitoring
situations.outcome: Restored trust through transparency and concrete improvements
